title: PGC Reference Implementation: Transformation Lifecycle (transformation)
description:
The governed change-request to protocol-artifact pipeline, holding two compilers: a Design Compiler driving phases P0-P8 to an Authoring Mandate, and a Construction Compiler rendering artifacts from the approved design alone.

Part of the Protocol-Governed Computing reference corpus. Cite the version DOI of the release you used, not the concept DOI.
notes: Implements or supports the Open PGC Standard (10.5281/zenodo.22150616). Version is taken from the GitHub release tag; do not hard-code it here.
